name: InterMIND
description:
InterMIND is a space for everyday communication in the language you think in — meetings, chat and recaps, confidential and free for participants. Connect it once and Claude works with your InterMIND account from the conversation where it already works with your CRM, help desk or calendar.

Meetings: create a meeting link you own (drop it into a calendar invite, a deal or a ticket; anyone who opens it knocks and you admit them) or schedule a meeting at a time, written to your connected Google or Microsoft calendar with the invitees. Reading: your recent and upcoming meetings, the newest recaps, a search over your recaps for what was decided, the transcript of a meeting by speaker, your channels and their messages, and the documents shared in your meetings. Acting: post a message in a channel as you — every member reads it in their own language.

Ten tools: create_meeting_link, schedule_meeting and post_channel_message write; the other seven are read-only. OAuth 2.1 sign-in with your InterMIND account; the connection appears in Settings and can be revoked at any time. Claude only sees meetings you host or attend.

_published_faq.name: How do I add InterMIND to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add InterMIND to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://intermind.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the InterMIND MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: InterMIND provides these MCP tools: create_meeting_link and list_recaps.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to InterMIND?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to InterMIND in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
InterMIND requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
InterMIND is developed by MindMeeting OÜ. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
